name: Swipe-action Row
hint: Swipe a row left slowly: the action bubbles pop in one by one. Keep going and Delete stretches into a pill.
description: List rows with swipe actions for React Native, shown as a mail inbox with generated avatars. The trailing actions are bubbles that pop in one by one as the finger uncovers them, overshooting with the swipe itself. Past the full-swipe line the others shrink away and Delete stretches into a liquid pill whose leading edge rides the row, with a heavy haptic; releasing commits it and the list springs shut. Swiping right does the same for Read and Unread. One row open at a time, every action is also a screen-reader action, and deletes can be undone.
intents: mail inbox rows with swipe actions
usage: Use for quick actions on items people triage often (mail, tasks, notifications). Always offer the same actions another way (a long-press menu or the detail screen), and make destructive full swipes undoable.
